title: The Dark Knight
synopsis: Gotham is, by night, mostly yours. A man in face paint has burned a mountain of money. He doesn't want money. You don't know yet what he wants.

nodes.text: You stand on a rooftop. Gordon, below, signals. The bat-light is, in fact, a habit.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Duty.
“Wait one more night” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Patience.

nodes.text: A robbery: six clowns, killing each other. The vault is full. The boss is a man named the Joker.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Track the trail” back. Investigate shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: Gotham's white knight. He wants to clean up the city. He is, you realize, who you wish you were.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Strategic.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Caution.

nodes.text: Rachel is dating Harvey. You are, in the suit, no good for her. You decide what to do with that knowledge.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
There is no taking “Be her friend” back. Hopeful shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The mob bosses meet by video. The Joker, uninvited, joins. He offers them his services. He scares them.

choices.consequence: “Identify the mob's allies” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Investigate.
You commit to “Identify the Joker first.” The story records the instinct as “Priority” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: An accountant named Lau has fled to Hong Kong with mob money. You bring him back.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Stealth.
There is no taking “Loudly” back. Statement shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Dent announces he is Batman to draw Joker out. He isn't. You realize Dent is, in his way, you in a suit.

choices.consequence: “Let it happen” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Trust.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Protect—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A trap. Dent in transit. The Joker attacks the convoy.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mission—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Capture Joker” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Goal.

nodes.text: Joker in a chair. You hit him. He laughs. You realize hitting him is, in fact, the thing he wants.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Discipline.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Anger.

nodes.text: Rachel and Dent are each held in a building rigged to explode. You can save one.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Choose Rachel” back. Heart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Choose Dent.” The story records the instinct as “Mission” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The Joker lied about the addresses. You arrive at the one with Dent. Rachel dies.

choices.text: Tell Dent it was an accident
choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Lie.
“Tell him the truth” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.

nodes.text: Dent burns. Dent breaks. Dent becomes Two-Face. The white knight is gone.

choices.text: Save what you can of him
choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Save—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: An accountant threatens to reveal your identity. Joker says, if Reese isn't killed in an hour, a hospital explodes.

choices.consequence: “Protect Reese” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Joker, in a nurse's uniform, walks the wards. He finds Dent. He turns him.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Get there first.” The story records the instinct as “Speed” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Trap—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Two ferries, one of civilians, one of prisoners. Each has the other's detonator.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Trust—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Action.

nodes.text: Neither boat presses the button. Joker is, briefly, surprised. He decides to do it himself.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stop him fast.” The story records the instinct as “Race” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Style.

nodes.text: You use Lucius' city-wide phone sonar to find Joker. The technology is, in its way, monstrous.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Compromise.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Principle.

nodes.text: Top of a building. SWAT and Joker. You save the SWAT, you take the Joker.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Vow.
You commit to “Disable him brutally.” The story records the instinct as “Anger” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Two-Face has, in his last hours, killed five men. He has hostage Gordon's family on a rooftop.

choices.text: Take the fall for Dent's crimes
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Take the fall for Dent's crimes” back. Hero shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Dent dies. Gordon's son lives. You tell Gordon to call you a villain. He does.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Sacrifice.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The bat-signal is, by morning, broken. You ride into the dawn. You are, in this story, the villain Gotham needs.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Stay the villain” back. Vow shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Hope.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You ride alone for years. The myth grows. Eventually, when the city needs you again, you return. The signal, restored, finds you on the same rooftop.
Years later, when Gotham is stronger, you reveal what Dent did. Gotham survives the revelation. You retire. Wayne Manor, restored, becomes a children's home.
You disappear. The signal is dismantled. You let the city heal without you. Lucius, alone in the bunker, archives the suit. You build, instead, a foundation.
